title: Reproducibility package for an auditable cross-scale provenance recovery framework for fragmented geological records
description: Reproducibility package for the major revision of 'An Auditable Cross-Scale Provenance Recovery Framework for Fragmented Geological Records'. The revision_20261102 directory supplies registered D3 inputs, engine 0.4-r5, twelve-configuration predictions, a 429-relationship documentary development reference, an anonymized 89-record single-reviewer source-document assessment, paired comparisons, six source reports and SHA-256 manifests. The 52 accepted associations comprise laser 3, thin-section 5 and grain-size 44; hyperspectral and XRF are assessed in other-state and diagnostic checks. The package also retains the original demonstration/tabular release and a replay of the historical 261-link rule, with their versions and evidence scopes distinguished. Computational reproducibility and relationship validation are documented separately.
